title: Pure Gravekeeper's
summary: Pure Gravekeeper's tomb-guarding control build, locking down the graveyard and hand around the supreme authority of Necrovalley. The deck converts Gravekeeper's Commandant and Recruiter into immediate Field Spell access, shuts off Special Summons and graveyard movements, and establishes Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist to protect Necrovalley from destruction.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gravekeeper's Commandant discards itself from hand to search Necrovalley directly from your Deck, and becomes a 2100 ATK beater on field under Necrovalley.
Gravekeeper's Recruiter searches any Gravekeeper's monster with 1500 or less DEF whenever it is sent from the field to the GY (including when linked into Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden).
Necrovalley Throne adds any Gravekeeper's monster from your Deck to your hand, or grants an immediate additional Normal Summon of a Gravekeeper's monster.
Terraforming searches Necrovalley directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Gravekeeper's Recruiter + Necrovalley
steps: Link Summon Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden using Gravekeeper's Recruiter as material.
Recruiter triggers upon hitting the GY to search Gravekeeper's Commandant (or Gravekeeper's Spiritualist).
Discard Commandant to add Necrovalley from your Deck to your hand, then activate Necrovalley.
If Necrovalley Throne or Spiritualist is in hand, Normal Summon Gravekeeper's Spiritualist and fuse into Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist.
Activate Royal Tribute to force both players to discard all monsters in their hands to the GY.

summary.title: Floodgates & Graveyard Lock
points: Necrovalley boosts all Gravekeeper's monsters by 500 ATK/DEF, prevents either player from banishing cards from the GY, and negates any card effect that would move a card in the GY to another location.
Royal Tribute forces both players to discard all monsters from their hand while Necrovalley is active, stripping the opponent of starters and handtraps.
Hidden Temples of Necrovalley prevents both players from Special Summoning monsters, except Gravekeeper's monsters, while both a Gravekeeper and Necrovalley are on field.
Imperial Tombs of Necrovalley is an omni-negate Counter Trap that negates and destroys any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Gravekeeper's monster and Necrovalley.

summary.title: Boss & Field Protection
points: Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist is summoned via Gravekeeper's Spiritualist without a Fusion Spell: it prevents itself and any card in your Field Zone (Necrovalley) from being destroyed by card effects, and searches any Gravekeeper's monster or Necrovalley card in the End Phase.
Gravekeeper's Stele targets and adds 2 Gravekeeper's monsters from your GY back to your hand, bypassing Necrovalley's restriction by explicit text.
Gravekeeper's Descendant tributes another Gravekeeper's monster to destroy any card the opponent controls, triggering Recruiter's search.
Gravekeeper's Heretic is completely unaffected by all other card effects while Necrovalley is on the field.

allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Necrovalley directly from the Deck.
allow.Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden: Link-1 Spellcaster that links off Level 4 Gravekeeper's Recruiter on Turn 1—immediately triggering Recruiter's mandatory GY effect to search Gravekeeper's Commandant (which then searches Necrovalley!).

main: Gravekeeper's Commandant
Core starter: discards itself to the GY to add 1 'Necrovalley' from your Deck to your hand (and is a 2100 ATK beater on the field under Necrovalley).
Gravekeeper's Spiritualist

Level 4 Gravekeeper that Fusion Summons 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster (Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist) during your Main Phase while Necrovalley is on the field, using itself and monsters from your hand or field as material!
Gravekeeper's Recruiter

Mandatory trigger when sent from your field to the GY (including by linking into Link-1 Artemis!): adds any 'Gravekeeper's' monster with 1500 or less DEF (Commandant, Headman, Spiritualist, or Descendant) from your Deck to your hand.
Gravekeeper's Spy
2000 DEF Flip monster (2500 DEF under Necrovalley) that Special Summons any Gravekeeper's monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck when flipped face-up.
Gravekeeper's Headman
Level 3 Gravekeeper that Special Summons 1 Level 4 Gravekeeper's monster from your hand or GY in Attack or face-down Defense Position when Normal or Special Summoned.
Gravekeeper's Descendant
Tributes 1 other face-up Gravekeeper's monster you control (like Recruiter, triggering its search!) to destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
Gravekeeper's Heretic
1800 ATK Gravekeeper that is completely unaffected by ALL other card effects while Necrovalley is on the field.
Necrovalley

Iconic Field Spell: boosts all Gravekeeper's monsters by 500 ATK/DEF, prevents either player from banishing cards from the GY, and negates any card effect that would move a card in the GY to a different place.
Necrovalley Throne
Searches any 'Gravekeeper's' monster from your Deck OR immediately Normal Summons 1 Gravekeeper's monster from your hand in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
Royal Tribute
Devastating Spell usable while you control Necrovalley: both players must discard ALL monsters in their hands to the GY!
Hidden Temples of Necrovalley
Continuous Spell usable while both a Gravekeeper's monster and Necrovalley are on the field: neither player can Special Summon monsters, except 'Gravekeeper's' monsters!
Gravekeeper's Stele
Bypasses Necrovalley by text to add 2 'Gravekeeper's' monsters from your GY back to your hand (recovering monsters discarded by Royal Tribute or Commandant!).
Imperial Tombs of Necrovalley
Counter Trap that negates and destroys ANY Spell, Trap, or monster effect while both a Gravekeeper's monster and Necrovalley are on the field.
Necrovalley Temple
Continuous Trap that reduces opposing monsters' ATK/DEF by 500, activates Necrovalley from hand/GY during the Main Phase, and sets a Necrovalley Spell/Trap from the Deck if destroyed.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Necrovalley.
extra: Signature Level 7 Fusion boss (2 Gravekeeper's monsters; summoned by Spiritualist): gains ATK/DEF equal to the combined original Levels of its materials x 100, prevents BOTH itself and any card in your Field Zone (Necrovalley!) from being destroyed by card effects, and searches any Gravekeeper's monster or Necrovalley card during the End Phase!
Link-1 Spellcaster that converts a Normal Summoned Gravekeeper's Recruiter into an immediate search for Gravekeeper's Commandant (and thus Necrovalley + Royal Tribute) on Turn 1!
